title: Customer Support Fundamentals — Test-Out Exam
description: A demonstration assessment for SCORM Quiz Builder covering the question types, scoring strategies, and attempt/feedback rules implemented in this build.
learnerInstructions: Answer all questions to the best of your ability. You have 2 attempts; your highest score will be sent to the LMS. Correct answers are shown only after your final attempt.
author: SCORM Quiz Builder Demo

questions.prompt: A customer's issue was resolved on the first contact. What metric does this best demonstrate?

options.feedback: Correct — FCR measures issues resolved without follow-up contact.
AHT measures duration, not resolution on first contact.
NPS measures likelihood to recommend, not resolution timing.
CES measures how much effort the customer had to exert.

feedback.correct: Correct! First Contact Resolution is the standard metric for this.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite — review the difference between FCR, AHT, NPS, and CES.

questions.prompt: It is always appropriate to place a customer on hold without asking permission first.
questions.trueFeedback: Incorrect — always ask permission before placing a customer on hold.
questions.falseFeedback: Correct — asking permission first is a baseline courtesy standard.

feedback.correct: Correct — asking permission first is a baseline courtesy standard.
feedback.incorrect: Incorrect — always ask permission before placing a customer on hold.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are recommended de-escalation techniques? (Select all that apply)

options.feedback: Yes — acknowledgment validates the customer's experience.

options.text: Match the customer's raised tone of voice
options.feedback: No — matching a raised tone tends to escalate, not de-escalate.

options.text: Offer a clear next step or timeline
options.feedback: Yes — a concrete next step rebuilds confidence.

feedback.correct: Excellent — you identified all the recommended techniques.
feedback.partiallyCorrect: Partially correct — review the techniques you missed or selected incorrectly.
feedback.incorrect: Review the de-escalation techniques module before retrying.

results.passingMessage: Congratulations — you've tested out of Customer Support Fundamentals!
results.failingMessage: You did not reach the passing score this attempt. Review the missed topics and try again.
results.attemptsExhaustedMessage: You have used both available attempts. Please contact your training administrator.
